files.conclusion: Original ANSI/Unicode keyboard handling, default button, tab/group/Enter/Escape and recursive item lookup remain C. F task/borrow scopes surround original keyboard entry; button scope delays BUTN reuse across focus callbacks and restores BST_DONTCLICK before releasing storage. S13 shared entry/lifetime boundary; no permanent exception.

Original tree/group/tab navigation remains C. Actual COFF undefined callable is _IsDescendant, resolved to C control-view-winmgr.obj; gcWheelDelta is a common tentative declaration already assigned C ownership. No F linked function observed. C0064 nevertheless imports F-selected original WND/CLS/layout/macros and declarations. S14 original USER header/layout composition, not wholesale source migration or duplicated B layouts.

Original mnemonic text matching, traversal, button flash and command behavior remain C. Four outer symbols are shared button enter/leave and task-aware GetWindowTextW/SendMessageW. Audit jointly with dlgmgr2 and button entry/cleanup in S13; do not split into parallel lifecycle paths.

mechanism.button: wow_button_scope_enter retains exact original BUTNWND on TLS stack. wow_button_free_state assigns deferred lookaside release to oldest matching invocation. Leave releases its resources then pending state; caller clears BST_DONTCLICK in finally before leave. Uses F native failure handling and resources, C BUTN/lookaside ABI and enclosing retained WND; not an SDK-only leaf.
mechanism.keyboard: wow_dialog_messageA/W -> task callback scope, borrow, capture/restore dialog context -> original IsDialogMessageA/W. Native CallMsgFilter/Dispatch/SendMessage use existing callback/identity restoration, not a second keyboard algorithm.
mechanism.layout: wow_user_client_view_layout.h selects original user.h bodies with opaque thread-type spelling, fixed x86 hook count and offset assertions; wow_shared_user_abi.h imports original wowuserp.h. Original client/precomp.h is absent from selected mirror; a C-owned header restoration/cohort must be reviewed in S14, not invented here.
